notes.title: New Version 1.3.2! Demo, Extras, Optimization, and More!
notes.content:
[h2]New Version 1.3.2 of Subject 124: The Man in the Suit![/h2]

Hello everyone, today you will finally be able to access this new version that I have been working on, which brings many new elements to the game, such as the new Extras section, a free demo, and most importantly, the optimization of all game models.

[h3]Extras[/h3]

In this section, you will find several subsections. The first is about the objects you have found during the game, the second is about the texts you have encountered, the third introduces a new VHS mechanic with important information, and the last one showcases sketches from the game's development.

[h3]Free Demo[/h3]

Now a demo of the game will be available, although it won't have much content. It will, however, allow players to appreciate the theme of the video game and make the decision to acquire it.

[h3]New Models and Optimization[/h3]

During these days, I have been remodeling the majority of the game's models since they were terribly optimized. I have also optimized smaller models, such as the objects you can find during the game. This has helped the game achieve significantly better performance compared to the previous version. In this video, you can see the improvement in performance.
[previewyoutube=6fYIdjA5wvk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Optimization Update
notes.content:
Firstly, I would like to apologize for the issues that arose with the game, including complaints about the high price and the errors that occurred during the launch. However, most importantly, I acknowledge the poor optimization of the game. I want to express my apologies and assure you that I am actively working on an optimization update. Additionally, I aim to introduce the extra features section to the game. I will strive to release this update as soon as possible so that you don't feel like your money was wasted.

Here are some of the things that will be included in the new version:

Optimization of all models
Content in the "Extras" section of the game
Free demo
I hope you can understand the current development situation of this game. Thank you.
